name: Nested Learning Spaces Form a Learning-Space Expansion
statement: If $S\subseteq B$ are learning spaces in the same coordinate orientation, then $E(B,S)$ is, after reflecting the new coordinate, a learning space and hence maximum-generated.
proof: Write the reflected class as $(S\times\{0\})\cup(B\times\{1\})$. Union closure holds within and between shores because $S\subseteq B$. Accessibility holds in the zero shore by accessibility of $S$; in a nontrivial one-shore state remove an old element using accessibility of $B$, and from the singleton new-coordinate state remove the new coordinate.
